title: The Crab and the Twig
lines: Beth and Raj dig in the wet sand.
A small crab jumps up from the sand!
Beth claps and steps back fast.
"Do not grab it," said Raj. "It nips."
The crab grabs a stick and slips off.
It hid in a crack next to a rock.
Raj sticks a twig in the flat sand.
The crab grabs it, and they both grin.

questions.ask: Why does Raj say not to grab the crab?
questions.listenFor: It nips. It is right there in his line of talking - have them find the quote marks.
In a crack next to a rock. If they say only "a crack," ask them where the crack was.

questions.ask: Why do you think Raj put the twig in the sand? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any sensible idea works, like "so the crab could have something to grab instead." Listen for a because.
